entries.en: Noreen folded the map carefully so that it would fit inside her coat pocket.
entries.zh: 诺琳小心地把地图折好，以便放进她的大衣口袋。

entries.en: The parcel arrived while Dinah was watering the plants on her balcony.
entries.zh: 包裹送到时，黛娜正在给阳台上的植物浇水。

entries.en: Niki asked the guide whether the walking route included any steep steps.
entries.zh: 妮基问导游，这条步行路线是否有陡峭的台阶。

entries.en: Elise kept the receipt in case the new lamp stopped working.
entries.zh: 伊莉斯留着收据，以防新台灯出了故障。

entries.en: Clifton offered to carry the heavier suitcase up to the third floor.
entries.zh: 克利夫顿主动提出把较重的那个行李箱提到三楼。

entries.en: Anita lowered the music when she noticed that the baby had fallen asleep.
entries.zh: 安尼塔发现宝宝已经睡着后，把音乐的音量调低了。

entries.en: Ely could not find the small screwdriver he needed to tighten the handle.
entries.zh: 伊利找不到拧紧把手所需的那把小螺丝刀。

entries.en: Before sending the invitation, Josephine checked that the date was correct.
entries.zh: 发出邀请之前，约瑟芬确认了一遍日期是否正确。

entries.en: Maynard took the earlier bus because the next service was usually crowded.
entries.zh: 梅纳德坐了较早的一班公交车，因为下一班通常很拥挤。

entries.en: Eugene marked the damaged tiles with chalk before ordering replacements.
entries.zh: 尤金先用粉笔标出了损坏的瓷砖，然后才订购替换用的瓷砖。

entries.en: Adelaide smiled when she found her grandmother's handwriting inside the cookbook.
entries.zh: 阿德莱德在烹饪书里发现祖母的笔迹时，露出了微笑。

entries.en: The tailor asked Herman to stand still while the sleeve length was measured.
entries.zh: 裁缝测量袖长时，请赫尔曼站着别动。

entries.en: Sonia placed a towel beneath the vase to protect the wooden table.
entries.zh: 索尼亚在花瓶下面垫了一条毛巾，保护木桌。

entries.en: Jerome repeated the address slowly so that the driver could write it down.
entries.zh: 杰罗姆慢慢地重复了一遍地址，好让司机记下来。

entries.en: Beverly noticed a loose button just as she was leaving for work.
entries.zh: 贝弗莉正要出门上班时，发现一颗纽扣松了。

entries.en: Reginald compared the two photographs under the brighter light by the window.
entries.zh: 雷金纳德借着窗边较亮的光线，比较了两张照片。

entries.en: Regis left a spare key with a neighbour before going away for the weekend.
entries.zh: 里吉斯周末外出前，把一把备用钥匙交给了邻居。

entries.en: Kirby waited until the glue had dried before moving the repaired chair.
entries.zh: 卡比等胶水干了以后，才搬动修好的椅子。

entries.en: A sudden shower forced Everett to bring the freshly painted shelf indoors.
entries.zh: 一场突如其来的阵雨迫使埃弗雷特把刚刷好漆的架子搬进屋里。

entries.en: Kathy slipped a bookmark between the pages and went to answer the door.
entries.zh: 凯西把一张书签夹进书页，然后去开门。

entries.en: Phyllis saved the last slice of cake for the friend who was arriving late.
entries.zh: 菲利斯把最后一块蛋糕留给了那位晚到的朋友。

entries.en: Andre checked the bicycle brakes before setting off down the hill.
entries.zh: 安德烈骑车下山之前，检查了自行车的刹车。

entries.en: Lynne wrapped the fragile bowl in newspaper before putting it in the box.
entries.zh: 琳妮先用报纸包好那只易碎的碗，再把它放进箱子里。

entries.en: Brandon changed seats so that an older passenger could sit near the door.
entries.zh: 布兰登换了座位，好让一位年长的乘客坐在靠近车门的地方。

entries.en: Lyn stayed behind after the meeting to put the borrowed chairs back in the cupboard.
entries.zh: 林恩在会议结束后留了下来，把借来的椅子放回储物柜。

entries.en: Theodore read the instructions twice but still could not reset the timer.
entries.zh: 希欧多尔把说明读了两遍，却还是无法重置定时器。

entries.en: Saul moved the seedlings into the shade during the hottest part of the afternoon.
entries.zh: 索尔在下午最热的时候，把幼苗移到了阴凉处。

entries.en: Naomi drew a small arrow on the envelope to show where it should be opened.
entries.zh: 内奥米在信封上画了一个小箭头，标明应该从哪里拆开。

entries.en: The waiter brought Lucia a clean fork without being asked.
entries.zh: 露西娅还没开口，服务员就给她拿来了一把干净的餐叉。

entries.en: Werner turned off the engine so that everyone could hear the unusual noise outside.
entries.zh: 维尔纳关掉了发动机，好让大家听清外面那奇怪的声音。

entries.en: Rudolf balanced the tray on one hand while opening the kitchen door with the other.
entries.zh: 鲁道夫一只手稳稳地托着托盘，另一只手打开厨房的门。

entries.en: Omar measured the doorway to make sure the new sofa would fit through it.
entries.zh: 奥马尔量了门口的尺寸，确认新沙发能够搬进去。

entries.en: Mabel wrote the bus number on the back of her shopping list.
entries.zh: 梅布尔把公交线路号码写在了购物清单的背面。

entries.en: Presley returned the borrowed camera with its battery fully charged.
entries.zh: 普雷斯利归还借来的相机时，已经把电池充满了。

entries.en: Stacey covered the dough with a damp cloth and left it beside the stove.
entries.zh: 史黛丝用一块湿布盖住面团，把它放在炉子旁边。

entries.en: Enoch kept the old ticket because it reminded him of his first concert.
entries.zh: 伊诺克留着那张旧票，因为它让他想起第一次听音乐会的经历。

entries.en: Agatha opened the window a little to let the smell of paint escape.
entries.zh: 阿加莎把窗户打开了一点，让油漆味散出去。

entries.en: The librarian showed Upton how to renew the book without visiting the library.
entries.zh: 图书馆员向厄普顿演示了如何不用到馆就能续借那本书。

entries.en: Sheldon replaced the missing wheel on the toy train with one from a broken model.
entries.zh: 谢尔登从一个坏模型上取下一只轮子，补上了玩具火车缺失的轮子。

entries.en: Marvin paused halfway through the recipe to check whether he had added the salt.
entries.zh: 马文照着食谱做到一半时停了下来，确认自己是否已经加了盐。

entries.en: Gus held the ladder steady while his neighbour cleaned the gutter.
entries.zh: 邻居清理屋檐排水槽时，格斯稳稳地扶着梯子。

entries.en: Vince chose a quiet corner of the cafe where he could finish the report.
entries.zh: 文斯在咖啡馆里选了一个安静的角落，好把报告写完。

entries.en: Paulo divided the remaining bread equally among the four children.
entries.zh: 保罗把剩下的面包平均分给了四个孩子。

entries.en: Ludwig stopped humming when the announcement began over the station speakers.
entries.zh: 车站的扬声器开始播报通知时，路德维格停止了哼唱。

entries.en: Logan found that the tent poles were easier to fit together on level ground.
entries.zh: 洛根发现，在平地上更容易把帐篷杆接好。

entries.en: Denny borrowed a torch to look for the ring that had rolled beneath the bed.
entries.zh: 丹尼借了一支手电筒，寻找滚到床底下的戒指。

entries.en: Alexis put a second blanket on the bed after hearing the forecast for a cold night.
entries.zh: 亚历克西斯听到夜间将会寒冷的天气预报后，又在床上加了一条毯子。

entries.en: Cecilia preferred the handwritten note to the much longer email that followed it.
entries.zh: 比起随后那封长得多的电子邮件，塞西莉亚更喜欢那张手写的便条。

entries.en: Cindy held a sheet of white paper behind the leaf to make its shape easier to see.
entries.zh: 辛迪把一张白纸放在叶子后面，好让叶子的形状更清楚。

entries.en: Jeanne checked every pocket before deciding that her gloves were missing.
entries.zh: 珍妮检查了每个口袋，才确定手套不见了。

entries.en: Henrietta moved the houseplants away from the radiator before turning it on.
entries.zh: 汉丽埃塔打开暖气片之前，把室内植物移到了远处。

entries.en: Katy tied a bright ribbon to her suitcase so that she could recognise it quickly.
entries.zh: 凯蒂在行李箱上系了一条鲜艳的丝带，以便迅速认出它。

entries.en: Tito offered his seat to someone carrying a sleeping child.
entries.zh: 提托把座位让给了一位抱着熟睡孩子的人。

entries.en: Susie pinned the timetable above her desk instead of keeping it in a drawer.
entries.zh: 苏西把时间表钉在书桌上方，而不是收在抽屉里。

entries.en: Eliza returned to the shop because the receipt showed a charge for two umbrellas rather than one.
entries.zh: 伊莱扎回到商店，因为收据显示收了两把雨伞的钱，而不是一把。

entries.en: Katharine practised the opening sentence until she could say it without looking at her notes.
entries.zh: 凯瑟琳反复练习开场的第一句话，直到不用看笔记也能说出来。

entries.en: Olga left enough space between the shelves for the taller books.
entries.zh: 奥尔加在隔板之间留出了足够的空间，用来放较高的书。

entries.en: Cheryl noticed that one of the labels had come loose during the move.
entries.zh: 谢丽尔发现，有一张标签在搬运过程中松脱了。

entries.en: Francesca asked for the dressing to be served separately from the salad.
entries.zh: 弗朗西斯卡要求把调味汁与沙拉分开上。

entries.en: Lilian copied the directions to the museum onto a card that would fit in her wallet.
entries.zh: 莉莲把去博物馆的路线说明抄在一张能放进钱包的小卡片上。

entries.en: Cedric checked the lock once more before taking the lift downstairs.
entries.zh: 塞德里克乘电梯下楼之前，又检查了一遍门锁。

entries.en: Bessie set an extra place at the table when she heard that another guest was coming.
entries.zh: 贝茜听说还会来一位客人，就在餐桌上多摆了一套餐具。

entries.en: Alfonso turned the chair towards the window to get better light for sewing.
entries.zh: 阿方索把椅子转向窗户，以便借着更好的光线缝纫。

entries.en: Jorge returned the shopping trolley before going back to his car.
entries.zh: 豪尔赫先把购物车归还原处，然后才回到自己的车旁。

entries.en: Elena asked the mechanic to keep the worn part so that she could see what had failed.
entries.zh: 埃琳娜请修理工留下磨损的零件，让她看看哪里出了故障。

entries.en: Billie wiped the flour from the table before rolling out the next piece of dough.
entries.zh: 比利先擦掉桌上的面粉，再擀下一块面团。

entries.en: Maxine took a photograph of the arrangement before moving the furniture.
entries.zh: 玛克辛搬动家具之前，拍了一张原来布置的照片。

entries.en: Nicole put the wet shoes on newspaper rather than directly on the wooden floor.
entries.zh: 尼科尔把湿鞋放在报纸上，而不是直接放在木地板上。

entries.en: Margery read the final paragraph aloud to check whether it sounded too formal.
entries.zh: 玛杰里把最后一段读出声，检查语气是否过于正式。

entries.en: Selina chose a seat facing the entrance so that she would notice her friend arrive.
entries.zh: 塞琳娜选了一个面向入口的座位，好在朋友到达时看见对方。

entries.en: Spenser brought a reusable cup but forgot the lid on the kitchen counter.
entries.zh: 斯宾塞带了一个可重复使用的杯子，却把杯盖忘在了厨房台面上。

entries.en: Delia turned the label towards the light to read the small print.
entries.zh: 迪莉娅把标签朝向亮处，看上面的小字。

entries.en: Lowell waited for the cyclists to pass before opening the car door.
entries.zh: 洛厄尔等骑自行车的人经过后，才打开车门。

entries.en: Suzie packed the picnic basket, leaving the sandwiches on top so they would not be crushed.
entries.zh: 苏西收拾野餐篮时，把三明治放在上面，以免压坏。

entries.en: Rhoda tried a different key after the first one failed to turn in the lock.
entries.zh: 第一把钥匙在锁里转不动后，罗达试了另一把。

entries.en: Silvia kept a notebook beside the bed to write down ideas before she forgot them.
entries.zh: 西尔维亚在床边放了一本笔记本，好在忘记之前把想法记下来。

entries.en: Leila hung the coat on a wide hanger to help it keep its shape.
entries.zh: 利拉把大衣挂在宽衣架上，帮助它保持形状。

entries.en: Claus held the paper against the wall while his friend checked that it was level.
entries.zh: 克劳斯把那张纸按在墙上，朋友则检查它是否水平。

entries.en: Bertie borrowed a larger mixing bowl when the flour began to spill over the edge.
entries.zh: 面粉开始从碗边溢出来时，伯蒂借了一个更大的搅拌碗。

entries.en: Wilfred put the screws in a shallow dish so that none would roll off the table.
entries.zh: 威尔弗雷德把螺丝放进一个浅碟里，以免它们滚下桌子。

entries.en: Woodrow took the damaged book to the counter and explained what had happened.
entries.zh: 伍德罗把损坏的书拿到柜台前，解释了事情的经过。

entries.en: Selwyn checked the route for roadworks before starting the delivery round.
entries.zh: 塞尔温开始送货前，查看了路线上是否有道路施工。

entries.en: Annette loosened the knot carefully rather than cutting the ribbon.
entries.zh: 安妮特小心地解松了绳结，没有把丝带剪断。

entries.en: Avery placed the muddy boots outside and carried the clean bags into the hall.
entries.zh: 艾弗里把沾满泥的靴子放在外面，把干净的袋子拿进了门厅。

entries.en: Toni put the cake on a wire rack and waited for it to cool before adding the icing.
entries.zh: 托妮把蛋糕放在金属网架上，等它冷却后才加糖霜。

entries.en: Gladys kept the spare blanket within reach of the guest bed.
entries.zh: 格拉迪斯把备用毯子放在客床旁伸手可及的地方。

entries.en: Ingram asked for a written estimate before agreeing to have the window repaired.
entries.zh: 英格拉姆同意修理窗户之前，先要求对方提供书面估价。

entries.en: Natalie checked that the photograph was attached before sending the message.
entries.zh: 纳塔利发消息之前，确认已经附上了照片。

entries.en: Greta moved her chair a little so that she could see the demonstration clearly.
entries.zh: 格里塔稍微挪了挪椅子，好看清演示。

entries.en: Vivian let the phone ring while she carried the hot pan safely to the table.
entries.zh: 维维安先把烫锅安全地端到桌上，没有理会响着的电话。

entries.en: Lovell held the gate open until the last sheep had passed through.
entries.zh: 洛弗尔一直把门敞开着，直到最后一只羊走过去。

entries.en: Emile used a soft pencil to sketch the outline before adding any colour.
entries.zh: 埃米尔先用软铅笔画出轮廓，然后才上色。

entries.en: Gifford moved the meeting to a smaller room because only six people could attend.
entries.zh: 吉福德把会议改到了一间较小的房间，因为只有六个人能够出席。

entries.en: Roberta placed a second copy of the document in a separate folder.
entries.zh: 罗伯塔把文件的另一份副本放进了单独的文件夹。

entries.en: Erasmus stood back from the easel to judge the balance of the painting.
entries.zh: 伊拉兹马斯从画架前退后几步，观察画面的平衡。

entries.en: Antoine saved the torn envelope because the return address was still readable.
entries.zh: 安托万留着那个撕破的信封，因为寄件人地址仍然看得清。
